failureMessage: The bounded year-285 persisted run completed, but the monolithic uninterrupted/replay comparison did not complete within two hours and exposed no phase telemetry. The process was terminated with exit code 130 at the owner's direction. This is a failed acceptance, not an accepted long-running result.
requiredRemediation: Replace monolithic full-history reruns with resumable checkpoint-segment verification.
Emit phase and year progress during every acceptance stage.
Apply an explicit wall-clock budget and fail fast when it is exceeded.
Do not block the operator product on acceptance replay work.
